summary: Deep Science Ventures is active as a venture creator for science companies, but I could not verify a current public founder application window, rolling intake claim, or program dates from accessible official pages. The prior rolling-intake event should be reviewed rather than carried forward as current without fresh official evidence.

sources.title: Deep Science Ventures
sources.supports: Official site confirms Deep Science Ventures is active and describes its model as creating science companies, but the accessible homepage did not expose current application dates or a founder intake cadence.

sources.title: Deep Science Ventures - Portfolio
sources.supports: Official portfolio page supports that DSV remains an active venture creator with companies across science/deeptech themes; it does not provide application deadlines or current cohort dates.

notes: Existing event says rolling applications and funding up to 18 months, but current accessible official pages did not independently verify those details for 2026.
Because exact/current application cadence and dates were not public from authoritative accessible pages, proposed_event is null for merge-stage review.
